FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Idaho fishing licence

Anglers aged 14 or older need a licence. Unlicensed visiting children must fish with a licence holder and share that person's catch limit.

Visitor licence from$22.75 USDFirst day
Buy on the official site ↗Checked against official sources on 22 Nov 2026.

1Who needs a fishing licence in Idaho?

You need a licence

  • Residents and non-residents aged 14 or older.

You do not need one

  • Non-residents under 14 with a licensed companion; their catch counts toward the companion's limit.

2Which licence can you buy?

  • Per consecutive day bought at the same time$7 USDNon-resident additional day
  • First day$22.75 USDNon-resident daily
  • 3 days$44.75 USDNon-resident salmon/steelhead 3-day
  • Annual$108 USDNon-resident annual adult

Prices from the official source, checked 22 Nov 2026. Compare trip prices for all 50 states.

3Do you need an extra stamp or permit?

  • Salmon or steelhead permit$28.25 USDRequired for the relevant ocean-run species, including named hatchery fisheries; the special 3-day product includes coverage.
  • Depredation Management/Access fee$10 USDAdded to annual fishing licences.

4Where can you buy the licence?

Use Go Outdoors Idaho, licence vendors, Fish and Game offices, or 1-800-554-8685. Online and phone fees apply.

Buy on the official site ↗

5Rules to know before you fish

  • Carry required salmon or steelhead licences and permits.
  • Tribal reservations can require separate licences and rules.

Questions before your trip

What to confirm before the trip

Confirm the current water-specific rules and any salmon or steelhead permit before the trip.

Do I need a fishing licence in Idaho?

Anglers aged 14 or older need a licence. Unlicensed visiting children must fish with a licence holder and share that person's catch limit.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Idaho?

Non-resident daily: $22.75 USD; Non-resident additional day: $7 USD; Non-resident annual adult: $108 USD; Non-resident salmon/steelhead 3-day: $44.75 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Idaho?

Use Go Outdoors Idaho, licence vendors, Fish and Game offices, or 1-800-554-8685. Online and phone fees apply.
